name: ffmpeg-builds
description: Prebuilt FFmpeg shared libraries (no source build).

Windows and Linux binaries come from BtbN/FFmpeg-Builds; macOS binaries come from PyAV-Org/pyav-ffmpeg because BtbN does not publish macOS builds. The port only unpacks and repackages the upstream artifacts, so configuring FFmpeg itself is not possible here - pick the closest matching variant instead.

ffmpeg7.description: Use the FFmpeg 7.1 release branch instead of 8.1. Not available on macOS.

gpl.description: Use the GPL build variant (adds x264/x265 etc.; taints the whole program with the GPL). Ignored on macOS, where only a GPL build is available upstream.

master.description: Use the FFmpeg master snapshot instead of the 8.1 release branch. Not available on macOS.

swscale.description: libswscale: image scaling and colorspace conversion

tools.description: Also install the ffmpeg/ffprobe/ffplay executables into tools/ffmpeg-builds. Not available on macOS.
